name: EX6-TEMPORAL-0
note: Isolated temporal masks z1 v z2 v z3: is the launch step a special locus, or is TOKEN1's +21 the first point on an early-token sensitivity curve? Temporal law (extends EX6-MED-0-SEMANTICS): a router call with n_tokens>1 is the prompt batch and RESETS a PER-MODULE T=1 counter (keyed by id(block), exactly like the frozen tail_done state — 48 independent counters, never one global counter across the layer pass); each n_tokens==1 call increments its own module's counter; count 1/2/3 = z1/z2/z3. Zk arm = mask count-k call at EVERY MoE block: equal dose by construction, one temporal position across all 48 layers. Z1 is position-identical to LOC TOKEN1_ONLY. Delta_zk = pooled over seeds 7001/8002/9003 of (gate_zk - gate_NONE), 120/seed, native generator path (m.run_gate), named-80 keepset, greedy. Resolution law: the house pair floor is ~7 solves pooled; a pooled delta inside 11..13 sits between bar 3 (>=14) and bar 4 (<=10) and books honestly as UNRESOLVED band, no direction claim per seed below the floor. Artifact visibility (/watch): census.json, qual.jsonl, qual_perprob.jsonl ALWAYS-READABLE; treatment.jsonl, treatment_perprob.jsonl, treatment_stdout.log SEALED-UNTIL-QUALIFICATION (rc 0), SEALED-FOREVER-ON-FAILURE otherwise. Registered secondary reads (color, no bars, motivated by EX6-LOC-0-LEVELS difficulty dependence): per-level gate_per_level splits for every arm; paired per-problem rescue/break tables Zk v NONE from the perprob streams. DOSE CENSUS (registered disclosure + contrast admissibility, AMENDMENT -DOSE): equal dose holds per CALL, not per PROBLEM — a completion shorter than k generated tokens gives arm Zk zero dose on that problem (the count-k call never happens). The adapter counts zero-dose problems per Zk arm from the perprob streams (a row without the 'recall' key had no masked call) and the contrasts for bars 3, 4, and 5 are ADMISSIBLE only if the involved arm's zero-dose count is <= 36 of 360 pooled (10%); the counts book as disclosures either way. A bar-4 FIRE produced by short generations is a dose artifact, not a launch-step effect — this clause prices it.

none.description: nothing masked — anchor arm, must reproduce LOC NONE 64/61/66 cell-exact

z1.description: mask the FIRST T=1 router call per MoE block after prompt reset (position-identical to LOC TOKEN1_ONLY) — anchor arm, must reproduce 74/66/72 cell-exact

z2.description: mask the SECOND T=1 call per block (generated z2's routing), one temporal position x 48 layers

z3.description: mask the THIRD T=1 call per block (generated z3's routing), one temporal position x 48 layers

bars.name: QUALIFICATION
bars.description: strong qualification bridge, all six cells CELL-EXACT against the booked LOC receipt: NONE 64/61/66 and Z1 74/66/72 at seeds 7001/8002/9003. Any miss = INSTRUMENT-INVALID; the driver exits 3 before any Z2/Z3 cell runs and NO verdict of any class issues on Z2/Z3.

bars.name: CALL-POSITION-CENSUS
bars.description: outcome-blind call-shape census on seed-7001 problem idx 2 (completion runs past 3 generated tokens, so the decode label is witnessed; the predicate requires len(after)>=4): 48/48 MoE blocks each record a prompt-batch (n_tokens>1) reset followed by z1, z2, z3 in order then decode — proving the counter is per-module, not global across the 48-layer pass. Failure exits 3 before anchors.

bars.name: Z2-CURVE
bars.description: early-token-curve reading: Delta_z2 >= +14 (two thirds of Z1's anchored +21), signs 3/3 — the second generated token's routing is worth the same class as the first, z1 is not a special locus.

bars.name: Z1-SPECIAL
bars.description: launch-step-special reading: max(Delta_z2, Delta_z3) <= +10 (under half of Z1's +21) — later single-token positions buy materially less than the launch step at the identical dose.

bars.name: EARLY-DECAY-ORDER
bars.description: RESOLVED decay order at the house resolution floor: Delta_z2 - Delta_z3 >= +7. The exact gap books either way; |gap| < 7 is a tie (no ordering direction claimed — a +1 gap is not a prior win), gap <= -7 is a RESOLVED REVERSAL. An excursion is a result, never an alarm.

bars.name: DOSE-VALIDITY
bars.description: dose-validity sanity: zero-dose problems (perprob rows without a masked call) <= 36/360 pooled (10%) for BOTH Z2 and Z3. Gates the refutation predicate via precedence — a dose-confounded delta must not be able to refute the prior while the same confound books bars 3/4/5 UNRESOLVED. The per-bar contrast admissibility guards stay in force unchanged.

refuted_if: The house prior (z1 is a genuinely special launch-step locus) is REFUTED if, with the instrument qualified AND the dose valid (bars 1, 2, and 6), max(Delta_z2, Delta_z3) >= +14 pooled — ANY later single-token position worth the +14 class refutes z1-specialness, whatever the position ordering (a large z3 with a small z2 refutes it too). Judged only under bars 1, 2, and 6; a dose-confounded delta cannot refute. Bar 3 (Delta_z2 >= +14, signs 3/3) stays the specifically named slow-decay-curve alternative.
registered_prior: House, on the record, MEDIUM confidence: z1 IS special — its resulting representation is available to later attention and occurs maximally early, so it can influence the remaining trajectory (KV mediation itself remains HYPOTHESIS per EX6-LOC-0), and EX6-LOC's D1 potency (111/360) plus the joint-only rescue structure localize the leverage at launch; predict bar 4 FIRES (Delta_z2 and Delta_z3 both <= +10, likely single digits), bar 3 does not, bar 5 fires (resolved decay order at the +7 floor). The named live alternative, on the record: an early-token sensitivity curve decaying slowly from +21 — bar 3 fires, bar 4 does not — which would demote the launch-step story to position-generic early-decode fragility and make a dose/position curve (residue 4) the next rung.
